req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs. This is a critical feature for API observability, allowing developers to explore and understand the API endpoints. The test suite includes a positive test to verify the successful serving of the Swagger UI, a negative test to handle incorrect paths, and a boundary test to ensure the correct handling of the /docs endpoint.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_served_successfully
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert 'text/html' in response.headers['Content-Type']

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_invalid_path
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/invalid_docs')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_boundary_case
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs/')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert 'text/html' in response.headers['Content-Type']
